description: 🚀 Ready to uncover the mysteries of space? We’re enthusiastic beginners passionate about space,science, research, creative storytelling, and visual communication. We aim to build an exciting project using real NASA data to make space exploration more accessible and interactive.We welcome students,beginners,writers,designers and researchers. No prior experience is required-just creativity, curiosity, teamwork and a willingness to learn. Join us...Let's create something big together
